statement: Let p be an odd prime with X_p^+ finite. Then the fixed field of the kernel of the pro-p outer Galois representation on the fundamental group of P^1 minus {0,1,infinity} equals the maximal pro-p extension of Q(mu_p) unramified outside p.
depends_on: WB-0006.004; WB-0006.005; Hain-Matsumoto 2001; Brown 2012; Ferrero-Washington 1979; Iwasawa 1981; Wake-Wang-Erickson 2017, 2018; Fukaya-Kato 2012

statement: If p does not divide the class number of Q(mu_p)^+, then X_p^+ = 0, and the equality of Theorem 1.1(a) holds.
The equality of Theorem 1.1(a) holds for every odd prime p < 2^31.

Finite-level cup comparison: if cups of even classes generate the even part of H^2(P_n, Z/p^n(2)) at every level, the odd-odd companion numerators of the class-two extension do not vanish on any pole divisor (1+T_1)(1+T_2) = alpha.

Separation of Magnus coefficients: under the stated module hypotheses and the non-vanishing of the companion numerators on every pole divisor, the rational representation of the free pro-p group H is injective.
If L/K is cyclic of odd prime degree p, ramified at exactly one finite prime, which is totally ramified, and the p-part of the class group of K is trivial, then so is that of L.
